$comment: Preserved source content inventory. These files are immutable archival source: derived bundles and annotations are stored separately and must never overwrite them. Verified by scripts/verify_content.sh (requirements 1.3, 1.4).

migrationOrigin.note: Copy completed and verified byte-identical on 2026-09-19. The origin tree is no longer referenced by any build, asset path or configuration value in this repository (requirement 1.2). These files were never tracked in the origin project's git history, so the copies here are the only preserved instances.

totals.note: ~170 MiB on disk. Tracked via Git LFS (see .gitattributes) so the repository contains every asset needed to run, as the submission rules require, without putting 170 MiB of binaries into plain Git objects.

sourceMetadata.accuracyClaimWarning: This is the upstream model's COCO benchmark figure carried in the source JSON. It is provenance only and must not be restated as a measurement of this application's quality (requirement 17.7).
sourceMetadata.landmarkConvention: COCO, named keys with x, y, confidence
sourceMetadata.angleFieldWarning: The source 'angles' object uses eight names that reduce to four unique joint bends. Preserve verbatim for provenance; derive new features from landmarks (task 2.2).
sourceMetadata.schemaReferenceCaveat: That document is the origin project's own description. Its example header shows 30.0 fps / 5400 frames, which matches NEITHER preserved routine; trust this manifest's measured sampling values and the JSON headers themselves, not the example (task 2.1).

excluded.posesBackups: The origin tree's mobile/assets/poses_backups/ holds three timestamped archives (20251202_033009, 20251202_035431, 20251204_075814). They were deliberately NOT copied and must never be promoted to playable routines (task 0.6).

permissions.blocker: Both routines are commercial recordings with copyrighted audio and video. Submission rules forbid copyrighted music or third-party material in the public demo video without permission, and require the repository to contain all assets. Task 0.8 must record a permission basis per file and identify which routine, if any, is safe to feature publicly.
permissions.originProvenance: The origin project's asset README files record only filenames and that the media was excluded from git for size. They state no source, licence or permission basis, so provenance must be reconstructed from scratch.
